## Launch Status and Verification Confidence

The tracking pipeline has assigned a **high confidence score** of 95 out of 100 to ZetaChain (ZETA), alongside a confirmed lifecycle status. This classification reflects formal ecosystem actions rather than speculative social media chatter. Specifically, token holders have formally approved a structural plan to wind down the existing Layer-1 infrastructure and migrate the ZETA token utility to the Solana network.

Despite the high confidence rating regarding the governance decision, certain foundational execution details remain unverified at this stage. Contract addresses, exact technical execution parameters, and specific smart contract deployment dates have not yet been independently verified through secondary audit pipelines. Market participants evaluating this development must distinguish between a confirmed governance mandate and the fully executed technical delivery of the token migration.

The primary evidentiary source for this transition stems from documented governance actions and industry reporting. According to the tracked data stream, the primary signal involves token holders voting to approve the wind-down of the original Layer-1 network in favor of a Solana migration path.
